title: Cthulhu Fruit Monster
description: A surreal green octopus-like creature with a large rounded head covered in textured purple fruit sits centrally in a mystical setting. Blue liquid drips from its wide smiling mouth and multiple eyes while its tentacles curl on the reflective ground, surrounded by floating fruits, glowing flowers, and ancient glowing runes against a vibrant purple and green cosmic background.
